_doc: Music edit. Track: 'Discover' by Eugenio Mininni (Mixkit, Mixkit Stock Music Free License), instrumental strings + piano outro. No stretch (the picture is not cut to its tempo); every splice sits on the track's own bar lines (arrange.py grid 113.37 BPM, downbeats 1.969 + 2.117*n s) and the levels are shaped on the music bus.

segments.label: mu.intro: src bars 1-6 (4.09-15.50) -> film 4.0-15.41. The cello intro under the dare and the jump; the track's own string swell (bar 5, src 12.55) lands on 12.46, the caption 'No despiertas'; ridden down to silence for the black at 15.5.
segments.qa_ok: deliberate: the music bus is ridden to -40 dB by 15.48 for the black frame 15.5-16, so the cut is inaudible

segments.label: mu.dream: src bars 8-12 (18.91-29.40) -> film 20.9-31.39. Enters very low under the mom (21-24), the dream (24-28), the dark bar 10-12 strings under the storm; fades out into 'off'.

mu.weeks: src bars 13-23 (29.49-50.09) -> film 36.0-56.6. The track's own build (bar 13) into its tutti (bar 14, film 38.1) under weeks 3-6, ridden up from -14 to -3 dB. Hard cut at 56.6 (the black frame).
segments.qa_ok: deliberate hard cut: the picture cuts to black 56.6-57.0 and the music must stop dead

segments.label: mu.bloom: src bars 44-47 (95.12-103.58) -> film 57.0-65.46. Bar 44 is the track's loudest (top drop candidate, +2.1 rel dB); its downbeat enters from silence on 57.0 as the brain lights up.
mu.outro: src bars 61-66 (131.10-141.6) -> film 65.46-75.0. The solo-piano resolution (hopeful), bar line to bar line from the bloom; rings down to silence on the end card.
